_s9k_cullfrustum_basis: LevelRenderer.cullingFrustum (class_761 field_27740) is gone at 1.21.9 (javap -c: 1.21.8's prepareCullFrustum wrote it and renderLevel culled with it; 1.21.9's prepareCullFrustum returns the frustum into a local). rt/CbCullFrustum answers the frustum the frame culls with (kept at prepareCullFrustum's return by CbCullFrustumMixin, or one a 1.21.8 call set); a write makes the frame cull with it, through the slot CbCullFrustumMixin already honours (Veil / porting_lib read it through their AW or @Shadow).
